prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (sunless) tan or UV tanning (beds/booths)? And which area of Columbus (ZIP or neighborhood) do you want — downtown, Short North, Upper Arlington, Easton, etc.?

If you’re not sure yet, here’s a quick guide to pick the best salon in Columbus:

What to look for
- Type of service: airbrush/spray vs. stand-up or laying beds vs. red-light therapy. Choose based on your skin type and safety concerns (spray is safer than UV).
- Cleanliness and equipment: well-maintained booths/beds and fresh spray-tanning booths. Ask when machines were last serviced.
- Technician experience and certifications: a trained spray tech gives more natural results.
- Solutions and products: preview the brand (organic, DHA levels) and ask for a patch test if you’re sensitive.
- Reviews and before/after photos: recent customer photos and multi-year positive reviews matter more than a single 5-star.
- Pricing and packages: compare single sessions vs. monthly memberships and whether tips/products are extra.
- Safety practices: eye protection, ventilation for spray, recommended wait times, and pre/post care instructions.
- Cancellation and refund policies.

Typical steps to find the best salon in Columbus
1. Decide spray vs. UV.
2. Search Google Maps or Yelp for “spray tan Columbus OH” or “tanning salon Columbus OH,” sort by rating and recent reviews.
3. Read several recent reviews and look at customer photos.
4. Call and ask about technician experience, solution brands, price, and any specials.
5. Book a patch test or single session before committing to a package.

If you tell me which part of Columbus you’re in and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll find and recommend a few top-rated salons and give contact/price tips.
